name: Star Map
description: Stars of several magnitudes, loosely scattered, with fine lines joining them into constellations that wander across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( --z: @p(5%, 7%, 9%, 12%, 15%); --sx: $(round(5000 + 2700 * sin(1.9 * @x + 2.7 * @y + 0.3)) / 10000); --sy: $(round(5000 + 2700 * sin(2.3 * @x - 1.7 * @y + 1.9)) / 10000); --o: @p(20, 11, 21, 1, 10); --ox: $(floor(o / 10) - 1); --oy: $(o % 10); --lx: $(round(10000 * (ox + 0.5 + 0.27 * sin(1.9 * (@x + ox) + 2.7 * (@y + oy) + 0.3) - sx)) / 10000); --ly: $(round(10000 * (oy + 0.5 + 0.27 * sin(2.3 * (@x + ox) - 1.7 * (@y + oy) + 1.9) - sy)) / 10000); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: $(sx * 100)%; top: calc($(sy * 100)% - 1.1%); width: 100%; height: 2.2%; transform-origin: 0 50%; background: var(--color1); transform: rotate($(round(atan2(ly, lx) * 5729.58) / 100)deg) scaleX($(round(10000 * sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly)) / 10000)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: 1; width: @var(--z); height: @var(--z); left: calc($(sx * 100)% - @var(--z) / 2); top: calc($(sy * 100)% - @var(--z) / 2); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
